errors.evidence: The description claims that the legend indicates that the orange color corresponds to the annual percentage growth. However, the legend in the figure only shows an unlabeled orange square; it does not provide a textual label for the orange series.
When describing the trend of the orange line, the description omits the data point for the year 2019, which is 7.3%. It jumps from the 2018 value (7.8%) to the 2020 value (6.8%).
